opportunities.name: Paper lookup and note: arXiv advanced search → Semantic Scholar → note
opportunities.description: For a given topic and year, search arXiv advanced search, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, and save a summary note.
steps: Open arXiv Advanced search
Enter search term
Tick the date filter checkbox and choose specific year
Enter year in YYYY
Click Search
Open the top result
Copy its title
Open Semantic Scholar and search the title
Open the matching paper and read the first author and citation count
Open Notes, add new note '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, N citations' and press Enter

instances.values: graph neural networks traffic forecasting (incomplete, 2024 presumably)

opportunities.name: Case law lookup → statute lookup → note
opportunities.description: For a Supreme Court case, find it on CourtListener, then look up the cited statute on Cornell LII, and save a note with the citation, decision date, and statute.
steps: Search the case name in CourtListener keyword box and press Enter
Open the case result
Note the U.S. citation and decision date
Open Cornell LII and search the statute citation
Open the statute page and read its title
Open Notes, add '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)' and press Enter
